import pandas as pd
from functions import extract_pdf_text
pdf_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/e9a2c537-8232-4c3f-85b0-b52de6bcba99.pdf"
text = extract_pdf_text(pdf_path)
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.split('\n') if ln.strip()]
# Identify start after the header 'Books' to avoid category labels
try:
    start_idx = lines.index('Books') + 1
except ValueError:
    start_idx = 0
records = []
buffer = []
for ln in lines[start_idx:]:
    # Skip category labels
    if ln in ['Young Children's', 'Middle Grade', 'Young Adult']:
        continue
    buffer.append(ln)
    if len(buffer) == 5:
        # Title, Author, Publisher, Genre, Status
        records.append(buffer)
        buffer = []
# Create DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=['Title','Author','Publisher','Genre','Status'])
# Filter Rick Riordan
riordan = df[df['Author'].str.lower().str.contains('rick riordan')]
# Count not on shelves
not_on_shelves = riordan[riordan['Status'].str.lower().isin(['checked out','overdue'])]
print("Rick Riordan total:", len(riordan))
print("Not on shelves count:", len(not_on_shelves))
print(not_on_shelves[['Title','Status']])

import pandas as pd
from functions import extract_pdf_text
text = extract_pdf_text("/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/e9a2c537-8232-4c3f-85b0-b52de6bcba99.pdf")
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.split('\n') if ln.strip()]
start = lines.index('Books') + 1 if 'Books' in lines else 0
records, buf = [], []
for ln in lines[start:]:
    if ln in ['Young Children's', 'Middle Grade', 'Young Adult']:
        current_section = ln
        continue
    buf.append(ln)
    if len(buf) == 5:
        records.append((current_section, *buf))
        buf = []
df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=['Section','Title','Author','Publisher','Genre','Status'])
riordan = df[df['Author'].str.lower().str.contains('rick riordan')]
criteria = riordan['Status'].str.lower().isin(['checked out','overdue']) | ((riordan['Section'] == 'Middle Grade') & (riordan['Status'] == 'Available'))
updated = riordan[criteria]
print("Updated not-on-shelves count:", len(updated))
print(updated[['Section','Title','Status']])
